mods.name: SMART TRACK
mods.author: maximevincentclaudeai
mods.summary: Finds tracks that fit the playing track by BPM, compatible musical key and selected playlists.
mods.description: Find tracks in the USB library that fit the playing track: BPM (including pitch-fader adjustment), Camelot-compatible key and selected playlists. SMART TRACK also suggests a name for your set. Configure filters in Mod Menu > SMART TRACK; settings are saved on the USB drive. The mod reads rekordbox library and deck state only. It uses no network and does not patch firmware.
